facts.label: Cheats
facts.value: Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off your platinum save

facts.label: Mission replay
facts.value: None — keep a separate save at the start and end of every chapter

steps.name: Story + side missions, scan and study as you go
steps.text: Finish the story and enjoy it. Pick up optional missions as they appear (purple icons, plus black icons with pink letters), and along the way scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study animals through your binoculars. Everything you do before the ending already counts toward the 100% checklist. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends — it is the only thing in the game that can be missed.

steps.name: The 100% checklist + Challenges
steps.text: After the ending, Progress > Stats gains a 100% Completion entry. It is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required and collectibles only partly. You do need every robbery, every underwater discovery, every shooting range, every drone race and the Bret quest — plus 200 of the 277 base vehicle models scanned, 100 of the 255 animals studied, and 70 of the 80 Challenges. Collectibles to chase: 15 complete card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos. Robberies: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vault robberies.

steps.name: Strangers & Freaks + cleanup
steps.text: The checklist does not ask for the stranger quests, so they are usually what is left: finish the 8 stranger strands, the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, and any stray trophies that did not pop on their own. Then the platinum — Vice Got a Price! — pops by itself.

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
warnings: Positive Mental Attitude: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she mentions meditating, and accept. It raises the meditation counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, and it is unclear whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway, because it cannot be done after Chapter 1.

Quest givers can go temporarily unavailable during the story (Kenton, for example). Every trophy-related character comes back, so a quiet strand is not a lost one — but start stranger strands when they appear, because some have windows tied to story progress.
Time-sensitive optional missions marked with an hourglass do not affect trophies or 100%, and most side quests are not needed for 100% — so do not panic about every disappearing icon.
